summary: Nvni Group Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Staff delisting determination on July 28, 2026, after failing to regain compliance with the $35 million Market Value of Listed Securities requirement under Listing Rule 5550(b)(2) by the July 27, 2026 compliance date. The company timely requested a hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel, which stays suspension (originally set for August 6, 2026) and Form 25-NSE filing pending the Panel's decision. At the hearing, Nvni intends to present a plan to regain compliance under Rule 5550(b)(1) requiring $2.5 million stockholders' equity, anchored in an ongoing capital restructuring involving conversion of portfolio-company earn-out and convertible obligations. Shares continue trading under NVNI. Watch the Panel's decision and plan feasibility.
